newsitem.title: POLAND: BRE TO ISSUE 4.5 MLN SHRS TO COMMERZBANK.
newsitem.headline: BRE TO ISSUE 4.5 MLN SHRS TO COMMERZBANK.

text.p: Polish Bank Rozwoju Eksportu SA (BRE) shareholders will vote on May 28 on an issue of 4.5 million shares to Commerzbank , upping the German bank's BRE share to 48 percent, BRE's president said on Monday.
"We intend to propose shareholders a capital raise through an issue of 4.5 million shares," Krzysztof Szwarc told Reuters.
The bank earlier said it would either issue between 2.5 and 4.5 million shares or convertible bonds for Commerzbank.
Szwarc said Commerzbank would buy the shares at a price based on the stock's bourse price at any 20-session interval BRE's surpervisory board chooses once the central bank approves the issue.
Szwarc also said the bank's capital adequacy ratio had fallen to 9.6 percent at the end of this year's first quarter from 12.6 percent at the end of last year.
He said shareholders would also vote to raise the firm's capital by 200,000 shares in a management stock option, whose price would be one percent of what Commerzbank pays.
Management members would have until January 15, 2000 to exercise the option.
